title: Best Out of Waste
text: Students turned paper, sticks and everyday bits into new creations.
body:
Best Out of Waste invited students to make something new from materials that might otherwise be thrown away. Classrooms filled with paper, ice-cream sticks, glue and colour as everyone set to work.

Some folded bright paper fans and hanging decorations. Others built pictures, including a fish made from small reused pieces, and held them up with pride.

The competition showed how a little imagination can turn ordinary scraps into something worth keeping.
